The '''Wilderness Pond''' is located in the centre of the [[Wilderness]]. It is one of the locations on the [[River Lum]] [[canoe]] system, which players can travel to by making a [[waka canoe]]. There is no [[canoe station]] at the pond, so travelling here via canoe is a one way trip.

[[Moss giant]]s can be found around the pond, being the only ones that can be found in the Wilderness. [[Skeleton]]s and 6 [[chaos rune]] spawns can also be found around the pond.

Near the pond, there is entrance as well to as a one-way from the [[Revenant Caves]], and to the west, a [[Wilderness Obelisk]] can be found.

==Transportation==
* [[Canoe]] directly to the pond.
* [[Wilderness obelisk]] to level 35 Wilderness and run east.
* [[Revenant cave teleport]] and run south.

==Hunter==
{{Main|Wilderness Hunter area}}
To the south of the pond, a forest of dead trees can be found. Roaming amongst the trees, [[black chinchompa (Hunter)|black chinchompas]] can be found and captured with [[box trap]]s.
